shay.name: Shay
shay.title: FAMtastic Designs AI Business Concierge
shay.role_boundary: Shay explains proofs, gathers decisions, and keeps the handoff organized. Fritz and the FAMtastic team retain human authority for price, scope, approval, payment, and launch decisions.

offer.name: Booked & Branded
offer.status: founding-pilot recommendation; not a live Commerce SKU
offer.headline: Own the front door. Keep the chair moving.
offer.promise: A branded website and phone-friendly operating starter for independent appointment professionals who have outgrown the look and limits of a generic booking profile.
core: One custom mobile-first website direction selected from three working proofs
One-owner, one-location phone Booking Desk starter
Up to 12 services with duration, price, preparation, and policy notes
Request-to-book with confirm, propose-another-time, or decline decisions
Blackout dates, availability windows, and request status
Business-owned Square, Stripe Payment Link, Cash App Business, or reviewed payment handoff
A decorative-to-live QR placement after the business connects its own approved destination
Fresh consent-based testimonials with owner moderation
One year of FAMtastic-managed hosting and the existing Web Basics domain path
Shay-guided setup, proof explanation, and launch handoff
launch_path: Keep the current booking profile available during setup
Launch the branded site as the public front door
Route requests through the bounded Booking Desk starter
Move or deepen scheduling only after conflict, recovery, notification, and owner-control tests pass
not_included: POS replacement, payroll, inventory, chair rental, or commission accounting
Review scraping or migration from Booksy or another platform
Payment custody, stored card or bank details, or FAMtastic merchant processing
Automatic SMS, data migration, or client-record import
A promise to replace every feature of an existing booking platform
future_addons: Client history, notes, and consent-managed files
Business email, maintenance, analytics, and AI customer help

specialists.label: Shay
specialists.job: Keeps the customer promise, proof choices, questions, and human handoff understandable.

specialists.label: Shape Director
specialists.job: Turns one business-native motif into containers, edges, crops, dividers, and interaction rhythm.

specialists.label: Type Director
specialists.job: Builds hierarchy through scale, contrast, outline, serif-versus-sans tension, and editorial composition.

specialists.label: Message Director
specialists.job: Gives each direction one argument, one voice, one next action, and no invented customer claim.

specialists.label: Gemini Lite Image Studio
specialists.job: Uses the owned pilot hero as a visual canon and creates a distinct reference-led frame for every direction.

a.name: Signature Editorial

type.composition: large high-contrast serif, italic detail words, quiet uppercase metadata, disciplined reading width

shape.grammar: arched portrait windows, hairline rules, soft paper panels, circular craft seals

message.argument: The work deserves the same care before the appointment as it receives in the chair.

a.image_direction: Create a quiet premium editorial frame with tactile materials, natural window light, a deliberate craft gesture, human warmth, and generous negative space for elegant serif typography.

b.name: Signal Campaign

type.composition: oversized condensed-feeling uppercase, outlined echo words, staggered labels, high-contrast rhythm

shape.grammar: cropped bands, rotated ticket tabs, hard diagonals, oversized rings and signal bars
shape.pattern: repeating directional stripes and registration marks

message.argument: A strong result should be recognizable before the logo appears.

b.image_direction: Create a cinematic campaign frame with stronger contrast, candid motion, flash or colored practical light, an unusual crop, layered foreground depth, and clean negative space for oversized display typography.

c.name: Chairside OS

type.composition: dense interface labels, strong numeric hierarchy, compact utility type, one contrasting editorial phrase

shape.grammar: stacked status tiles, phone-safe cards, timeline rails, confirmation chips and modular docks
shape.pattern: subtle scheduling grid with status dots

message.argument: The owner should see the day, make the decision, and keep moving from one phone.

c.image_direction: Create an operator-first documentary frame between appointments: the owner uses a phone naturally in the real workspace, with service tools and brand materials visible, clean anatomy and screen-safe negative space. Do not render readable phone UI.

scenes.a: A composed after-cut portrait beside a walnut station: the Black barber brushes the client’s shoulder while the finished taper and beard line catch warm coastal daylight.
scenes.b: A lively early-evening barbershop moment: the Black barber pivots around the chair during a finishing pass, chrome tools and amber light creating streaks and foreground depth.
scenes.c: Between clients, the Black barber stands beside the clean chair reviewing a phone with clippers, appointment notebook, and an unbranded payment placard nearby.

image_rules.reference_rule: Use the attached owned fictional hero only as a visual canon. Preserve palette, material, lighting credibility, craft context, and casting intent. Create a wholly new photograph; do not reproduce pixels, exact people, faces, pose, crop, or background.
image_rules.exclusions: No words, logos, booking-platform UI, trademarks, flags, watermarks, readable phone screens, celebrity or identifiable real person, cloned faces, duplicated tools, malformed hands, extra fingers, unsafe practice, or generic stock-photo posing.
